name: refactor
title: Refactor safely - pin behavior, restructure in small steps, prove nothing changed
titleAr: إعادة هيكلة آمنة — تثبيت السلوك ← هيكلة بخطوات صغيرة ← إثبات إن مفيش حاجة اتغيرت
description: Behavior-preserving restructuring. Current behavior is pinned with characterization tests before any product line changes, the refactor lands in small verified steps, and the tester proves the pinned tests are byte-identical and still green. Structure metrics are reported before and after.

stages.title: Map the code to refactor
stages.prompt:
Refactoring goal: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Map the target area: responsibilities, call graph and every caller (file:line), the public surface that must not change (exports, CLI flags, HTTP routes, file formats, error messages), code smells with evidence (long functions, duplication, deep nesting, god objects, circular imports), and which behaviors existing tests already pin. Add `## Structure metrics (before)` - counts derivable by reading (function lengths, parameter counts, duplicated blocks, import fan-in/fan-out) with the file:line each comes from. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
done: analysis.md lists every caller of the target code and the public surface that must stay unchanged, with file:line citations
analysis.md contains a Structure metrics (before) section
analysis.md states which behaviors existing tests cover and which are unpinned

stages.title: Refactor plan
stages.prompt:
Refactoring goal: {TASK}

Grounding: .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md (project {PROJECT}). Produce the plan per your role contract as a sequence of small behavior-preserving steps, each independently verifiable and revertible. Include the characterization tests to add first (which unpinned behaviors, which inputs and expected outputs), the invariants that must hold (public surface, outputs, error messages, performance budget), target structure metrics, and what is explicitly out of scope. Write it to .workbench/artifacts/plan.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the refactor plan - pin behavior and proceed?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع خطة إعادة الهيكلة — نثبّت السلوك ونكمل؟
done: plan.md exists and contains all required sections (Task, Requirements, Chosen approach, Steps, Acceptance criteria, Risks)
plan.md lists the characterization tests to write before any product change
Every step is behavior-preserving, names concrete files and can be verified on its own

stages.title: Pin current behavior
stages.prompt: In the project at {PROJECT}, implement ONLY the characterization tests listed in .workbench/artifacts/plan.md - do not modify any product (non-test) file. Follow the repository's test conventions, run the tests against the unchanged code and make them pass. Write code-notes.md per your role contract and add `## Pinned tests`: each test file with its `git hash-object <file>` value, the command that runs them and its passing output.
done: Characterization tests exist for every behavior the plan lists, or code-notes.md justifies each omission
No product (non-test) file was modified in this stage
code-notes.md contains a Pinned tests section with each file's git hash-object value, the run command and its passing output

stages.title: Refactor in small steps
stages.prompt: Apply the refactor steps from .workbench/artifacts/plan.md in the project at {PROJECT} one at a time, running the pinned tests and the suite after each step. Never edit the pinned test files listed in code-notes.md; if a pinned test fails, fix the refactor, not the test. Behavior, public surface and error messages must not change. Keep the Pinned tests section of code-notes.md intact, complete the rest per your role contract, and add `## Structure metrics (after)` measured the same way as analysis.md.
done: Every plan step is implemented or its omission is explicitly justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md still contains the Pinned tests section and adds a Structure metrics (after) section
code-notes.md gives the commands that run the pinned tests and the full suite

stages.title: Prove behavior is unchanged
stages.prompt: Verify the refactor in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Prove four things: (1) the full suite and the pinned tests pass; (2) every pinned test file still has the `git hash-object` value recorded in code-notes.md; (3) the public surface listed in analysis.md is unchanged; (4) the structure metrics moved in the direction the plan targeted. Write review.md per your role contract and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
review.md shows the recomputed hash of every pinned test file next to the recorded one
review.md confirms the public surface is unchanged and quotes the before/after structure metrics

stages.title: Fix behavior drift
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL for the refactor in the project at {PROJECT} (details in .workbench/artifacts/review.md). Restore identical behavior by fixing the refactored code - never by editing a pinned test. If a step cannot be made behavior-preserving, revert it and say so. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is fixed or the offending step is reverted, stated explicitly
No pinned test file was modified
debug.md shows the failing output before and the passing output after

stages.title: Ship the refactor
stages.prompt: The refactor PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. The commit message must state that behavior is unchanged and cite the before/after structure metrics. Write ship.md.
stages.gateQuestionAr: اتأكدنا إن الهيكلة مغيرتش السلوك — أعمل commit؟
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
No .workbench/ or local-only files staged
The commit message states behavior is unchanged and cites the structure metrics
